digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict signing and provenance tracking
propositions: Signed verdicts currently record only a model string and cannot distinguish between first-class providers (Anthropic, Bedrock) and best-effort (Ollama, custom base_url) backends, requiring provenance to be added as an additive payload field.

The provider_provenance object must contain provider name, resolved model, endpoint_host (extracted safely without credentials), tier classification, and the effective ModelCapabilities record from the run that produced the verdict.

Provenance must be assembled once per runner execution from already-computed data (provider name, base_url, tier, capabilities) and reused in all three sidecar writers (plan_review, completion, code_review) rather than recomputed, to prevent divergence from the record that actually drove the run.

Credential material (userinfo from base_url, api_key) must never appear in the persisted sidecar payload; endpoint_host extraction must use urlparse().hostname, not .netloc, to strip embedded credentials.
The additive-only design preserves backward compatibility: legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance remain loadable and valid, and readers treat absence as 'unknown, legacy'.

Provider provenance must be threaded from runner.run() through finalize_verdict at all five call sites (workflow_ops coach step, recovery paths, completion gate) so the verdict dict reaching build_payload carries the assembled record.
